result.summary: The page is generally well organized, but some text has low contrast and one restaurant name appears clipped.

issues.description: The search placeholder and inactive bottom navigation labels are light gray and appear to have insufficient contrast against their backgrounds.
issues.suggestion: Darken the text and navigation icons to meet applicable contrast requirements.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen restaurant name appears clipped at the end, despite available space before the rating.
issues.suggestion: Widen the title container or adjust its text layout so the full name is visible.
